status: PROPOSAL, 0707/05.13. Not enacted. Not a kernel rule. Works under the existing 0412 development agreement.
home: a fenced block ```task-agreement ... ``` inside the pack page (05.NN.md), BEFORE '## Return pointer', so it is part of the frozen pack cut. No companion file. Old packs without it are reported, not migrated.

binding.pack_cut: pack bytes from the start of the file to (not including) the line '## Return pointer'; the tool's own Return-pointer and Review writes therefore do not change it
binding.owner: compute measures at intake and stores the binding in the existing intake record (same intake id); nothing is copied into a second ledger

cut_kinds.heading: from the line '## <exact heading>' to before the next line starting '## ' (bytes as stored); must occur exactly once
cut_kinds.self-heading: a heading cut inside the same pack page
cut_kinds.whole: the whole file (only for short standing records)

states.cited: a cut is named, resolves exactly once, and its sha256 is recorded
states.unknown: no cut is named or the block is absent; the dependent acts wait (holds table)
states.none-recorded: only for recorded_decisions: Prime declares that no Director decision applies; an explicit empty list, not a default
states.not-applicable: needs a reason text; for example finish_criteria of a pure discussion page
states.stale: a bound cut's bytes now differ; the old binding is kept; no automatic rebinding
states.conflict: two cited cuts disagree on the same field; both kept; Director judgment; only the dependent act waits

fields.name: goal
fields.cites: a self-heading (for example '## Goal' or '## Question / selected evidence')
fields.supplier: intelligence names the cut; compute measures

fields.name: scope
fields.cites: self-heading(s) naming included, excluded and allowed writes
fields.supplier: intelligence names the cut(s); compute measures

fields.name: finish_criteria
fields.cites: self-heading (for example '## Return' or '## Deliverables / boundaries')
fields.supplier: intelligence names the cut; compute measures

fields.name: prime_discretion
fields.cites: a standing record (0412/01 '## Local work agreement'; director-agreement 'whole') and optionally a self-heading narrowing it
fields.supplier: intelligence names the cut(s); compute measures

fields.name: director_required
fields.cites: a standing record (director-agreement 'whole') plus any pack-specific stop line
fields.supplier: intelligence names the cut(s); compute measures

fields.name: recorded_decisions
fields.cites: a list of decision bindings (below), or none-recorded
fields.supplier: intelligence selects; compute measures and checks the pairing

fields.name: gloss
fields.cites: free text by Prime, labelled interpretation; never authority

rules: verbatim_cut and interpretation_cut are different cuts of the same record file
answers_cut names the proposal or question the reply answers (a heading cut, in the same or another named record)
answers_scope is 'only the cited proposal or question'; it never widens to a general release
a reply resolves only its answers_cut; other holds remain

holds.scope unknown: action release for builder execution waits; recording and publishing a preliminary review may continue
holds.prime_discretion unknown: a Prime-only release waits; recording continues
holds.director_required unknown: nothing is inferred either way; any act Prime marks consequential waits for the Director
holds.recorded_decisions unknown: answers cannot close holds; held items stay held
holds.any stale: the acts that depend on that field wait until reconciled
holds.any conflict: the acts that depend on that field wait for the Director

never: select a source by newest file, fuzzy keyword or heading guess
treat a heading, link, model label, Boolean or the word 'yes' as authentication or approval
copy Director text into a second approved ledger
rebind silently to a changed or newer revision
fill an unknown so that a form turns green
treat a mechanical refusal as rejection of the idea
